exact_cas_identification.notes: CAS.PRG plus observed part, indices, hardware, software, production date, supplier and variant metadata.

exact_dde_identification.notes: D_MOTOR.GRP resolved to D71N47C0.PRG with observed identification metadata.

exact_egs_identification.notes: GS19D.PRG with observed part, indices, hardware, software, production date, supplier and variant metadata.

kl15.notes: KLEMMENSTATUS 64 and 65 map to KL15 inactive; 69 maps to KL15 active. Never suitable alone for engine-running.

kl50.notes: CAS.PRG/status_fzg_zustand KLEMMENSTATUS bits 4-5 followed KL50 OFF -> ON -> OFF across independent read-only observations.

kl50_oem_start_transition.notes: OFF -> ON -> OFF is present across independent read-only observations. TestO adds same-clock sequential CAS/DDE correlation, not simultaneous physical timing.

kl50_duration.notes: The IFH Level 3 interval 720-827 ms remains the tighter observation. Sequential TestO independently bounds this acquisition to 571-1134 ms; neither establishes an exact physical duration.

kl50_rpm_temporal_alignment.notes: CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSTIC_CORRELATION on one Date.now() clock: samples 10-12 observed KL50 ON with 131/224.5/863 rpm, then sample 13 observed KL50 OFF with 981.5 rpm. CAS precedes DDE by 52-53 ms in these loops, so exact physical order remains UNKNOWN.

engine_speed.notes: 0 rpm stopped, cranking/rise, idle and rundown values are present across Tool32 and multiple TestO observations.

engine_running_state.notes: Stopped, cranking and stabilized-running phases are now present across two real OEM-start observations; the future algorithm remains unvalidated and KLEMMENSTATUS remains disqualified as standalone engine-running evidence.

stopped_cranking_running_observations.notes: Physical STOPPED, CRANKING and RUNNING phases observed in two real starts; no final thresholds inferred.

transmission_pn.notes: Tool32 status_getriebeposition correctly followed physical P and N observations.

transmission_prnd_tool32.notes: P/R/N/D physical positions mapped to P/R/N/D through GS19D.PRG status_getriebeposition.

brake.notes: ISTA Brake actuated coherently followed released/pressed pedal; repetition still required.

engine_running_detection_algorithm.notes: Candidate hysteresis, consecutive-sample and timeout strategy only. No final thresholds and no control use.

terminal_50_start_request.notes: KL50 state is confirmed, but the request source or mechanism that causes it remains unknown.

cas_start_button_request.notes: No CAS START-button or start-request signal has been functionally identified.

oem_start_request_source.notes: The observed KL50 transition does not identify the OEM request source.

remote_start_actuation_mechanism.notes: No remote-start actuation or diagnostic command mechanism has been identified.

msa_start_correlated_bits.notes: MSAAV bit 5 and MSAAA/MSAEV bit 2 changed near one OEM start; correlation only.

msa_bit_functional_meaning.notes: No MSA bit is identified as KL50, starter request, authorization or CAS request.

oem_start_authorization.notes: The IFH trace confirms terminal state only and does not expose the OEM authorization mechanism.

start_inhibit_conditions.notes: Potential P/N and brake observations are not yet a validated start-inhibit policy.

can_identifiers.notes: No CAN identifier carrying KL50 or start-related information has been observed or added.

klemmenstatus_decoding.notes: Documented two-bit fields consistently decode observed 64/65/69/85 values.

kl_r_state_observation.notes: KL_R OFF/ON states are derived from documented bits in observed 0x40/0x41/0x45/0x55 values.

kl15_state_observation.notes: KL15 OFF/ON states are derived from documented bits and the observed full cycle.

kl50_cranking_correlation.notes: Two independent read-only sessions observed KL50 ON with rising RPM; correlation only, not a command or causal mechanism.

synchronized_diagnostic_acquisition.notes: CAS then DDE were read sequentially in one process/session on one Date.now() clock; not simultaneous.

oem_start_sequence_observation.notes: Both sessions contain KL50 OFF/ON/OFF and RPM rise/stabilization sequences.

oem_stop_sequence_observation.notes: The diagnostic sequence 69 at idle, then 64 with 779.5/438.5/215/0 rpm is confirmed; no stop mechanism is inferred.

key_insertion_correlation.notes: 64 to 65 was observed during the user-declared key-insertion sequence; this capture alone does not prove causality.

brake_press_signal_this_session.notes: The session measured only KLEMMENSTATUS and RPM. Brake press is user-declared context, not a captured signal.

automatic_key_ejection.notes: Automatic key ejection and its coding are user-declared and were not directly measured.

starter_disengagement_algorithm.notes: Two observed starts are insufficient to define or validate a starter-disengagement algorithm.

physical_start_stop_button_signal.notes: START/STOP presses were declared by the user but no button signal was captured.

remote_stop_actuation_mechanism.notes: The observed OEM stop cycle reveals no remote-stop actuation mechanism.
